---

EMMA is a decision-support site for protected areas in South Africa’s Cape Floristic Region—a Global Biodiversity Hotspot and UNESCO World Heritage Site (~20% of Africa’s plant diversity) where fire, climate, and land use shape fynbos. It provides up-to-date regional summaries and park-level reports on vegetation condition, anomalies, fire history, and veld age, in partnership with SAEON.

Open a park on the map below, or compare anomalies and veld age across parks.


# Parks and regional veld age

Regional veld age (years since last known fire; color scale capped at 20 for display). Click a park outline for the full report—greenness, fire history, invasives, and climate.

```{r, echo=F}
  base_url <- "https://adamwilsonlab.github.io/emma_report/reports/"
  base_url <- "reports/" #keep relative paths?
  
    reports <- 
  data.frame(report = list.files("reports/",pattern = "*.qmd")) %>%
    mutate(url = paste(base_url,gsub(pattern = ".qmd",replacement = ".html",x = report),sep = ""),
           park_name = gsub(pattern = "report.",replacement = "",x = report),
           park_name = gsub(pattern = ".html",replacement = "",x = park_name),
           park_name = gsub(pattern = ".qmd",replacement = "",x = park_name),
           park_name = gsub(pattern = "_",replacement = " ",x = park_name)) %>%
      mutate(
          park = glue::glue("[{park_name}]({url})"),
          park = map(park, gt::md))
  
  protected_areas <-
  protected_areas %>%
    st_as_sf() |> 
    inner_join(y = reports,
               by = c("name"="park_name"))%>% 
    st_transform(crs = st_crs(4326))%>% 
   mutate(tag = paste0("Park: <a href=", url,">",name , "</a>"))

  bbox <- st_bbox(protected_areas) %>%
  as.vector()


```

```{r park_map, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# Continuous veld-age raster (same product / naming as park pages after #57).
years_since_fire_map <- years_since_fire.tif
years_since_fire_map[years_since_fire_map > 20] <- 20
years_since_fire_pal <- leaflet::colorNumeric(
  palette = "Reds",
  domain = c(0, 20),
  reverse = FALSE,
  na.color = "transparent"
)

index_overlay_groups <- c("Park", VELD_AGE_GROUP)

index_map <- leaflet(data = protected_areas) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "World Imagery") %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.NatGeoWorldMap", group = "NatGeo") %>%
  addRasterImage(
    x = raster::raster(years_since_fire_map),
    group = VELD_AGE_GROUP,
    layerId = "veld_age_index",
    colors = years_since_fire_pal,
    opacity = 0.7
  ) %>%
  addPolygons(
    color = PARK_OUTLINE_COLOR,
    weight = PARK_OUTLINE_WEIGHT,
    opacity = 1,
    stroke = TRUE,
    fill = TRUE,
    fillOpacity = 0.05,
    fillColor = PARK_OUTLINE_COLOR,
    group = "Park",
    popup = ~tag
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = years_since_fire_pal,
    values = c(0, 20),
    title = "Veld age<br/>(years)",
    opacity = 1,
    group = VELD_AGE_GROUP
  ) %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("World Imagery", "NatGeo"),
    overlayGroups = index_overlay_groups,
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE),
    position = "topright"
  ) %>%
  fitBounds(bbox[1], bbox[2], bbox[3], bbox[4]) %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender(park_map_layer_stack_js(index_overlay_groups))

index_map

```

# Vegetation anomalies by park

```{r, echo=F, warning=F}

# Quantile extract column names follow the terra layer name (e.g. "evi", "Years");
# rename by position so website CI survives layer-name changes.
protected_areas_monthly_delta_evi <- extract(monthly_delta_evi.tif,protected_areas,fun=quantile,na.rm=T) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(-1) |> #drop the index
  setNames(c("Q0", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")) |> 
  bind_cols(name=protected_areas$name)

```

```{r, echo=F, warning=F,fig.cap="Median monthly ΔEVI by park—higher = greener than typical for this month. Parks ordered low to high; open a park on the map for detail. Definitions: Data."}

protected_areas_monthly_delta_evi |> 
  filter(!is.na(Q50)) |> 
  mutate(name = fct_reorder(as.factor(name), Q50)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = name)) +
    # Full range (min to max)
    geom_segment(aes(x = Q0, xend = Q100, yend = name), color = "grey70", linewidth = .5) +
    # Interquartile range (Q25 to Q75)
    geom_segment(aes(x = Q25, xend = Q75, yend = name), color = "grey40", linewidth = 1) +
    # Median point
    geom_point(aes(x = Q50), size = 2, color = "black") +
    labs(
      x = "Mean Vegetation Anomaly (EVI)",
      y = "Protected Area",
      title = "Distribution of Vegetation Anomalies",
      subtitle = "Showing full range (Q0–Q100), IQR (Q25–Q75), and median (Q50)"
    ) 


```


# As-of dates

See the [Data](data.qmd) page for STAC links, GitHub release tags, coverage definitions, and COG how-to. Product as-of dates:

```{r, echo=F, results='asis'}
# build table of dates when products were last updated

weather_updated <- if (is.data.frame(weather_data) &&
                       "YEARMODA" %in% names(weather_data) &&
                       nrow(weather_data) > 0L) {
  format(max(weather_data$YEARMODA, na.rm = TRUE), "%Y-%b-%d")
} else {
  "unavailable"
}
dates <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(Description = "Website", Date = format(now(), "%Y-%b-%d")),
  data.frame(
    Description = "EVI (VIIRS→Terra→Aqua fill)",
    Date = format(most_recent_evi_date, "%Y-%b-%d")
  ),
  data.frame(Description = "Weather", Date = weather_updated)
) |> 
  select(Description, "Date last updated"=Date)

knitr::kable(dates)
 
```
